text:
sam: flagged: saw ~52 April invoices with a usage line but unit_price=0 so line total is $0.00. Stripe shows the line but NS mapping drops it.
leah: ugh. any idea which change caused unit_price to be 0? pricing experiments?
sam: looks like a feature-flagged experiment (experiment/pricing-multiplier-3) accidentally rolled to 10% of prod via a bad targeting rule. it set multiplier to 0 for a short window.
nico: that would produce invoices with usage.quantity present but unit_price 0. we treat line_total=quantity*unit_price downstream so NetSuite mapping sets revenue=0 and creates orphaned credits.
feature-flag-bot: deploy: experiment/pricing-multiplier-3 rollout -> 2026-04-03T10:12:33Z -> 10% prod segment (rule: region in [eu,us] && cohort_beta=true)
leah: do we have a list of affected customer ids? sam: yes pulled from webhook logs where invoice.created had metadata.experiment=pricing-multiplier-3 between 10:12 and 10:17. I exported ~52 invoice ids into /tmp/zeroed-invoices-0403.csv
finance-bot: nightly-reconcile detected 47 mismatched invoices, created alert TKT-5642
nico: quick mitigation: rollback the experiment immediately and enqueue backfill to recalc unit_price for those invoices using billing history/pricing table.
feature-flag-bot: experiment/pricing-multiplier-3 rollback initiated by leah at 2026-04-03T10:18:02Z
sam: starting targeted backfill now (non-destructive): job_id=bfill_0403_pricing_01. will attempt to PATCH invoice lines in Stripe where metadata.marked_zero=true.
leah: side note: our webhook->ns mapper treats unit_price==0 as a signal to skip mapping (to avoid mapping free credits). We need a stricter check: skip only when priced_free flag=true or plan.sku in free_plans.
nico: agree. Add guard and a monitor: alert when Stripe invoice has usage.quantity>0 && unit_price==0.
sam: backfill progress: attached corrected lines for 41 invoices, 11 failed due to tax_code mismatch in NetSuite mapping (customer missing region). filing follow-up.
finance-bot: backfill complete: success=41, failed=11, duration=12m 4s, job=bfill_0403_pricing_01
leah: filing incident and postmortem. action items: 1) tighten flag targeting and add prod kill-switch, 2) change mapper skip-logic, 3) add metric invoice.zero_unit_price_count, 4) improve experiment rollout audit.
feature-flag-bot: incident created: INC-2026-118-pricing-flag-production-exposure
sam: created follow-up tickets for the 11 NS mapping failures and assigned to @nico. I'll upload the csv and backfill logs to the ticket.
